title: Ecosystem Dynamics
definition: Ecosystem dynamics refers to the study of the continuous flow of energy and the cycling of nutrients through the biotic and abiotic components of an ecosystem, leading to changes in structure and function over time.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding environmental degradation, climate change impacts, and biodiversity conservation strategies in both Prelims (conceptual) and Mains (GS Paper III).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ecosystem Dynamics.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
